# superset_chart (Resource)

Manages a chart in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_chart" "example" {
  slice_name    = "Example Table"
  viz_type      = "table"
  datasource_id = superset_dataset.example.id
  params        = jsonencode({ metrics = ["count"] })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datasource_id` (Number) ID of the dataset this chart is built on.
- `params` (String) JSON string of chart form data / configuration.
- `slice_name` (String) Display name of the chart.
- `viz_type` (String) Visualisation type (e.g. 'table', 'bar', 'line').

### Optional

- `cache_timeout` (Number) Cache timeout in seconds. 0 means no cache expiry; -1 falls back to the datasource default.
- `datasource_type` (String) Type of the datasource. Defaults to 'table'.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the chart.
- `query_context` (String) JSON string of the query context. Optional — when omitted Superset auto-generates it.

### Read-Only

- `datasource_name` (String) Name of the datasource (read from API).
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the chart.
- `url` (String) URL path to the chart in the Superset UI.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the chart assigned by Superset.
